ceiling_directive: Extend the bow row-span dichotomy to the published finite-ADMG object by proving a recursively composable district-fixing criterion with causal realizability and bounded positive twins for every failed step.
improvement_directive: Augment the one-fixing certificate with the complete graph-implied independent-edge-source equalities and prove an if-and-only-if lift theorem with an explicit finite latent-support bound. Then prove that this certificate composes under recursive fixing.
critique: The proved complete identification criterion applies only to the two-node bow, not to general finite ADMGs. The ordinary-ID component is a single numerical front-door reconstruction, while no general ordinary-ID reduction, terminating district calculus, complexity result, or regular-inference theorem is proved. The one-fixing section instead disproves the proposed algebraic certificate and characterizes only an empty two-node example; the load-bearing independent-edge-source lift remains open. Thus the exact bow equivalence and rank frontier are a narrow subfield contribution rather than the advertised complete finite-ADMG theory, although the TL;DR and scope sections disclose this restriction rather than falsely claiming it solved.
